clause: Generative result lands as local authority + promotion [STU-VEC-040]

scope.summary: Ensure every adapter-backed generative result lands as ordinary local StudioDocument content (editable vector geometry, patterns, or recolored artwork) subject to the same authority/history/export surfaces as hand-authored geometry, carries a KernelActor attribution marking it model/adapter-authored, and passes the sandbox->validation->PromotionGate lifecycle before it changes document authority.
acceptance_criteria: generative result lands as editable local content via PromotionGate with KernelActor attribution; fails closed on direct write
proof_targets: generative promotion fail-closed + KernelActor attribution test
expected_tests: live: generative result enters sandbox->validation->PromotionGate before authority write (fails closed); lands as editable local geometry with KernelActor model attribution

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Generative output bypasses promotion/attribution; authority corruption + unauditable model edits.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
